sections.title: COWLS survey papers
sections.intro: The three papers that present the COWLS sample. They cover every lens in this release.

sections.title: Papers using the COWLS sample
sections.intro: Work by other groups that uses the COWLS catalogue or images as a whole, for example to train a lens finder or to compare with another lens search.

sections.title: Papers on individual COWLS lenses
sections.intro: Studies of specific COWLS lenses. The thumbnails link to each lens's page.

sections.title: Earlier work on COWLS lenses
sections.intro: Papers that studied a lens before it was catalogued by COWLS, or independently of it.

sections.title: Earlier strong-lens searches in COSMOS
sections.intro: Strong-lens searches in the COSMOS field that came before COWLS, mostly in HST imaging. Where COWLS credits a search with first finding a lens, its thumbnail is shown.

papers.label: COWLS I
papers.title: The COSMOS-Web Lens Survey (COWLS) I: Discovery of >100 high redshift strong lenses in contiguous JWST imaging
papers.summary: Presents the COWLS catalogue of over 400 lens candidates, more than 100 of them high confidence, found by eye in COSMOS-Web JWST imaging, together with their lens models and this data release.

papers.label: COWLS II
papers.title: The COSMOS-Web Lens Survey (COWLS) II: depth, resolution, and NIR coverage from JWST reveal 17 spectacular lenses
papers.summary: Presents the 17 most spectacular COWLS lenses (the M25 tier) and shows what JWST's depth, sharpness and near-infrared coverage reveal in them.

papers.label: COWLS III
papers.title: The COSMOS-Web Lens Survey (COWLS) III: forecasts versus data
papers.summary: Compares forecasts of how many lenses COSMOS-Web should contain, and what they should look like, with the lenses COWLS actually found.

papers.title: High-Redshift Gravitational Lens Discoveries in JWST NIRCam Using AnomalyMatch
papers.summary: Trains the AnomalyMatch machine-learning lens finder on 11 of the COWLS II lenses, then searches JWST imaging for new lenses and finds 58, several of which are COWLS candidates.

papers.title: JWST's PEARLS: A clumpy ring galaxy at z = 4.0148
papers.summary: Uses the Einstein radii of the COWLS candidates to test whether a ring-shaped galaxy at redshift 4 could be a lens.

papers.title: Galaxy-scale lens search in the PEARLS NEP TDF and CEERS JWST fields
papers.summary: Searches two other JWST fields for galaxy-scale lenses and compares their redshifts and Einstein radii with the COWLS catalogue.

papers.title: Unveiling a Population of Strong Galaxy-Galaxy Lensed Faint Dusty Star-Forming Galaxies
papers.summary: Finds 18 lensed, faint, dusty star-forming galaxies in COSMOS-Web; nine are COWLS lenses, and their magnifications broadly agree with the COWLS values.

papers.title: The lens mass in the Einstein ring JWST-ER1
papers.summary: Reinterprets the mass of the JWST-ER1 lens (the COSMOS-Web ring) from earlier published measurements.

papers.title: The COSMOS-Web ring: Spectroscopic confirmation of the background source at z = 5.1
papers.summary: Measures the redshift of the galaxy lensed into the COSMOS-Web ring with spectroscopy, placing it at z = 5.1.

papers.title: The COSMOS-Web ring: in-depth characterization of an Einstein ring lensing system at z~2
papers.summary: A detailed study and lens model of the COSMOS-Web ring.

papers.title: A Radio Galaxy Gravitational Lens in the COSMOS-Web Survey
papers.summary: A short research note on a lens whose lensing galaxy is a radio galaxy, seen in COSMOS-Web imaging.

papers.title: CDM and SIDM Interpretations of the Strong Gravitational Lensing Object JWST-ER1
papers.summary: Asks whether the mass of the JWST-ER1 lens can be explained by cold or self-interacting dark matter.

papers.title: A massive compact quiescent galaxy at z=2 with a complete Einstein ring in JWST imaging
papers.summary: Discovers JWST-ER1, a complete Einstein ring around a compact galaxy at redshift 2, in COSMOS-Web imaging.

papers.title: A photo-z cautionary tale: Redshift confirmation of COSBO-7 at z=2.625
papers.summary: Spectroscopic redshift (z=2.625) of the strongly lensed dusty galaxy COSBO-7.

papers.title: A Survey of Dynamical and Gravitational Lensing Tests in Scale Invariance: The Fall of Dark Matter?
papers.summary: Review of scale-invariant gravity tests, with a section (6.3) treating JWST-ER1's lensing-to-stellar mass excess without dark matter.

papers.title: A large population of strongly lensed faint submillimetre galaxies in future dark energy surveys inferred from JWST imaging
papers.summary: JWST discovery of a z~3.4 submm galaxy lensed by a z=0.36 galaxy in COSMOS.

papers.title: Combining strong and weak lensing estimates in the Cosmos field
papers.summary: Line-of-sight shear from modelling COSMOS lensed arcs (COSMOS 0038+4133, 5758+1525, 5921+0638) combined with cosmic shear.

papers.title: Survey of Gravitationally-lensed Objects in HSC Imaging (SuGOHI). II. Environments and Line-of-Sight Structure of Strong Gravitational Lens Galaxies to z ~ 0.8
papers.summary: Environment and line-of-sight analysis of known lenses in HSC, including several COSMOS lenses.

papers.title: The SL2S Galaxy-scale Lens Sample. V. Dark Matter Halos and Stellar IMF of Massive Early-type Galaxies out to Redshift 0.8
papers.summary: Dark-matter halo and IMF analysis of the SL2S sample, including SL2SJ095921+020638.

papers.title: The SL2S Galaxy-scale Lens Sample. III. Lens Models, Surface Photometry and Stellar Masses for the final sample
papers.summary: Lens models and stellar masses for the SL2S galaxy-scale sample, which includes SL2SJ095921+020638.

papers.title: The SL2S Galaxy-scale Lens Sample. IV. The dependence of the total mass density profile of early-type galaxies on redshift, stellar mass, and size
papers.summary: Density-slope analysis of the SL2S sample, including SL2SJ095921+020638.

papers.title: Discovery of a Quadruple Lens in CANDELS with a Record Lens Redshift z=1.53
papers.summary: Discovery of the z=1.53 quadruple lens in CANDELS/COSMOS with LBT spectroscopy of the z=3.42 source.

papers.title: On the evolution of environmental and mass properties of strong lens galaxies in COSMOS
papers.summary: Environment and dark-matter fraction of the 20 COSMOS multiple-image lenses, with new redshifts.

papers.title: COSMOS 5921+0638: Characterization and analysis of a new strong gravitationally lensed AGN
papers.summary: VLT spectroscopy, HST imaging and mass modelling of the quadruply lensed AGN COSMOS 5921+0638.

papers.title: Hubble Asteroid Hunter: II. Identifying strong gravitational lenses in HST images with crowdsourcing
papers.summary: Citizen-science search of archival HST images for serendipitous strong lenses, including COSMOS pointings.

papers.title: Survey of Gravitationally-lensed Objects in HSC Imaging (SuGOHI). IV. Lensed quasar search in the HSC survey
papers.summary: HSC-SSP lensed-quasar search that re-found the known COSMOS quad HSCJ095921+020638.

papers.title: Survey of Gravitationally-lensed Objects in HSC Imaging (SuGOHI). V. Group-to-cluster scale lens search from the HSC-SSP Survey
papers.summary: HSC-SSP group/cluster-scale lens search; lists HSC J0959+0219D, grade A.

papers.title: LensFlow: A Convolutional Neural Network in Search of Strong Gravitational Lenses
papers.summary: Machine-learning (CNN) search of the HST COSMOS imaging that presented 92 lens candidates.

papers.title: "Super-deblended" Dust Emission in Galaxies: II. Far-IR to (sub)millimeter photometry and high redshift galaxy candidates in the full COSMOS field
papers.summary: Super-deblended far-IR/submm COSMOS catalogue that identified strongly lensed submm galaxy candidates.

papers.title: The CFHTLS-Strong Lensing Legacy Survey (SL2S): Investigating the group-scale lenses with the SARCS sample
papers.summary: Ground-based CFHTLS arc search (SARCS sample) that includes COSMOS-field lenses.

papers.title: AzTEC millimetre survey of the COSMOS field - III. Source catalogue over 0.72 sq. deg. and plausible boosting by large-scale structure
papers.summary: AzTEC 1.1 mm COSMOS survey whose source-count excess flagged lensing candidates.

papers.title: On the contribution of large scale structure to strong gravitational lensing
papers.summary: Correlates the COSMOS strong-lens candidates with weak-lensing and X-ray large-scale structure.

papers.title: First catalog of strong lens candidates in the COSMOS field
papers.summary: Visual search of the HST/ACS COSMOS imaging that found 67 galaxy-galaxy lens candidates, the first COSMOS lens catalogue.

papers.title: Gravitational lenses and lens candidates identified from the COSMOS field
papers.summary: Complete manual inspection of ~285,000 COSMOS HST galaxies that recovered Faure's lenses and listed 112 more candidates.
